head: RoomLane turns a photo of a room into a redesign plan
dek: RoomLane lets you draw walking lanes on a photo of a room and pin style ideas like warmer light to walls, to plan a change. It was #78 among free Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, free
means: If you're rearranging a room, you can test ideas on one photo first.
todo: Find RoomLane in the App Store.
thumb_words: PLAN A ROOM FROM ONE PHOTO
